props.body: Synthetic retry budget is three attempts.

cypher: CREATE VECTOR INDEX ssg_embedding ON :Embedded(embedding) WITH CONFIG {"dimension": 4, "capacity": 32, "metric": "cos"}
name: create-vector-index

cypher: CALL vector_search.search('ssg_embedding', 12, $v) YIELD node,similarity RETURN node.key AS key,similarity ORDER BY similarity DESC,key
name: vector-search

cypher: MATCH (n:Embedded) RETURN n.key AS key,vector_search.cosine_similarity(n.embedding,$v) AS similarity ORDER BY similarity DESC,key
name: ssg-exact-cosine

cypher: EXPLAIN MATCH p=(n:RecordVersion {key:$seed})-[:CORRECTS|SUPERSEDES|SUPPORTED_BY*1..4]-(x) RETURN x.key AS key,[r IN relationships(p)|{type:type(r),source:r.asserting_source,hash:r.asserting_hash,channel:r.channel}] AS provenance ORDER BY key,provenance LIMIT 64
name: explain-replacement-evidence

cypher: MATCH p=(n:RecordVersion {key:$seed})-[:CORRECTS|SUPERSEDES|SUPPORTED_BY*1..4]-(x) RETURN x.key AS key,[r IN relationships(p)|{type:type(r),source:r.asserting_source,hash:r.asserting_hash,channel:r.channel}] AS provenance ORDER BY key,provenance LIMIT 64
error: {code: Memgraph.ClientError.MemgraphError.MemgraphError} {message: Comparison is not defined for values of type map.}
name: replacement-evidence
